description: Tool makers: submit or claim an Agent Tool Card (schema: https://toolwork.org/schemas/agent-tool-card/v0.1.json). Held for verification, never auto-trusted. To claim, serve the text toolwork-claim=<submission_id> at https://<your-domain>/.well-known/agent-tool-card-claim.txt (your-domain must be the entry's publisher domain), then call verify_claim(submission_id).

card.description: What an agent needs to know before using a tool: who runs it, what it does, how to connect, auth, side effects, human steps, blockers, verification and provenance. License: CC0-1.0. Version 0.1 (2026-10-25). Fields may be null when unknown; never guess.

health.description: Machine verification: last handshake, status, latency, auth_required, tool_count, uptime_30d

step.description: Aliases accepted on input and normalized: api_key -> obtain_api_key, 2fa -> two_factor, manual_dashboard_click -> dashboard_click

id.description: Stable permanent ID, e.g. mcp:com.example/server, api:example.com, mcp:docker/<key>

official.description: Vendor-official: the tool is run by the vendor of the service it exposes. Not the same as publisher_verified.

publisher_verified.description: The publisher proved control of its domain (e.g. to the Official MCP Registry). A verified third party can still wrap someone else's API.

related_links.description: Optional links to related external resources (e.g. a registry of known changes and advisories), added by Toolwork rules. Plain links only.

card.title: Agent Tool Card

name: submit_tool_card
